title: Rectangles as records
prompt: Define a record type (struct) Rect with integer fields width and height, a function that takes a Rect and returns its area, and a function that takes a Rect and returns its perimeter. Create the three rectangles 3 x 4, 10 x 2 and 7 x 7 (width x height) and, for each, print its area and its perimeter on one line as `area perimeter` separated by a space.
